SDK default build: Win64 clamps to 0xF0000000; Win32 default FastPos rejects >128 MiB before handle mutation. These are SDK codec bounds, not CPU/thread or GUI limits.
LZMA numThreads >1 selects real hash/BT/LZ pipeline when algorithm/BT permit; fast/HC remain ST as in SDK. LZMA2 block max 256; raw MT decoder max 32; Z7_ST max 1.

Auto follows effective process affinity and available memory. Ordinary choices end at effective logical CPU count; Other preserves positive Integer values, including >128. Packing dictionary presets reach 3840 MiB; benchmark reaches 4096 MiB.
size_t stays unsigned. Native caller allocators own actual handles, dictionaries, tables, rings and block buffers. High-level MemoryLimit and GUI admission retained. No codec CPU-count admission cap.
Reserved/unused by SDK 26.06 Lzma2DecMt.c. Preserved field, no invented input limit; output-block overflow/allocation failure falls back to ST.
Matches SDK, including its permissive result on some truncated input/oversized expected-output cases. The high-level container validators remain separate and strict.
Native Delphi API/interfaces and unchanged legacy 48/64-byte records/GUIDs. Not a C-callable DLL ABI. Full SDK property records are separate native types.
Delphi 13.2/RTL, Windows x86/x64, Z7_ST and 16/32-bit probabilities qualified. Native scalar behavior replaces optional SIMD/assembly speed paths. Benchmark parity is outside this validation.
As in C, callers must avoid signed-overflow/zero-division normalization inputs. Defaults, valid properties, invalid codec parameters and bounded I/O are covered.

One six-vCPU, one-group Win10 VM. Group-0 routing/real process affinity tested; physical multi-group hardware and kernel exhaustion not claimed. Win64 >2-GiB copy tested; Win32 largest contiguous region measured and allocation failure retained; >2-GiB Win32 physical copy not claimed.
